name: Personal Digital Affliction
source:
Charlie Sheridan is a 22 year old college student, studying the arts. Shortly before she's set to return home for Spring Break, she learns that a close friend of hers has passed away. From there, she learns about a supposedly cursed video that the friend had watched 3 days before their death. 

Looking into this video brings her down a rabbit hole that sees her exploring all over the town she's lived in, forced to reminiscence on what was and what could've been.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4685850/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
查莉·谢里丹是一名22岁的艺术系女大学生。就在春假即将返乡前夕，她突然得知自己的一位挚友不幸离世；随后她更是听说，那位朋友在去世前3天曾观看过一段据称受到诅咒的视频。

对这段视频的追查将她引向了深不见底的谜团，促使她踏遍自己生活至今的整座小镇，在探寻真相的过程中不得不直面往昔的回忆与那些未曾实现的可能。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4685850/]Steam[/url]]
